sourcesContent: .register-container { max-width: 400px; margin: auto; padding: 20px; background-color: #f9f9f9; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; transition: all 0.3s ease; } .register-container:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); } h2 { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 20px; color: #3498db; } input { padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; /* Slightly reduce margin for better spacing */ border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #ddd; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.3s; width: 100%; /* Full width for inputs */ box-sizing: border-box; /* Include padding in width calculation */ } input:focus { border-color: #3498db; outline: none; } .logo { display: block; /* Center the logo */ margin: 0 auto 20px; /* Center and add margin below */ width: 150px; height: auto; /* Maintain aspect ratio */ } button { padding: 12px; border: none; background-color: #3498db; color: #fff; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; transition: background-color 0.3s; width: 100%; /* Full width for the button */ } button:hover { background-color: #2980b9; } label { display: block; /* Stack the labels for better alignment */ margin-bottom: 5px; /* Space between label and radio buttons */ } div { margin-bottom: 20px; /* Space between role selection and other inputs */ } p { text-align: center; font-size: 14px; }
